transcript: Here are 5 signs you are not doing well financially. It gets increasingly harder, so if you pass all 5, you are in the top 1% of India. Number 5: Whenever you get a wedding invitation, you get worried about the gift ka kharcha, rather than being excited about going to the wedding. Number 4: If your salary gets delayed, you have to delay paying your rent and other basic expenses. Number 3: If your phone or laptop stops working, you cannot comfortably buy a new one on the same day. Number 2: If a travel or business opportunity comes up, you have to say no, purely because you don't have extra cash lying around. And number 1: If your parents have some medical issue, and the first thing that comes to mind is the expense, and not the wellbeing of your parents. If you failed at any of these levels, comment Money and I will teach you how to make more money.
caption: Comment “money” if you want to Make More Money
